tools.name: find_by_performer
tools.title: Find Venues by Performer
tools.description: Look up a band or solo performer across all 50 US states, Washington, DC, and British Columbia. With All Access, returns the artist dossier (genres, live draw / room-cap estimate, bio, typical headlining ticket price, booking/management contacts, website/socials, and top co-billed peers) plus every venue with past or upcoming show listings, dates, and source URLs. With a signed-in free account, returns aggregate show and venue counts across states. Anonymous callers are prompted to sign in.

performer.description: Band or solo artist name to search.

include_possible.description: Include fuzzy / possible lineup matches (default false).

state.description: Optional two-letter state/jurisdiction code (all 50 US states, "DC", "BC") or full name.

tools.name: find_similar_venues
tools.title: Find Similar Venues by Bands or Rooms
tools.description: Find live music venues across all 50 US states, Washington, DC, and British Columbia matched via direct bookings, shared-bill peer artists, and venue roster overlap from reference bands, reference venues, or one of the user's saved shortlists (All Access). Supports optional state, capacity, venue type, or driving route narrowing and renders the matched rooms in the interactive widget.

artists.description: 1 to 10 reference band or solo artist names with a similar sound or draw (e.g. ["The Band of Heathens", "Sierra Ferrell"]).

shortlist_id.description: Optional saved shortlist ID from list_shortlists to use as seeds.

state.description: Optional two-letter state/jurisdiction code (all 50 US states, "DC", "BC") or full name.

near.description: Optional origin town ("Austin, TX") or "lat, lng" coordinate pair.

to.description: Optional destination town ("Nashville, TN") or "lat, lng" for route-corridor filtering.

stops.description: Optional ordered list of 2 to 15 towns or coordinates to filter matches along a driving route.

within_miles.description: Maximum distance in miles from near or route corridor (default 25).

venue_type.description: Optional venue category filter (e.g. "Music venue", "Listening room", "Bar & pub").

tools.name: get_profile
tools.title: Get Account & Access Status
tools.description: Return the current user account profile, access level (anonymous, account, or pass), All Access expiration date, remaining free venue reveals, and saved venues count.

tools.name: get_venue
tools.title: Get Venue Details
tools.description: Read a single venue dossier by venue_id without spending a free reveal. Returns description, room layout, load-in and stairs notes, crowd vibe, The Scoop field notes, genres, and sample bands (for signed-in accounts and All Access), plus booking contacts, dead-email warnings, submission rules, typical ticket prices, usual music days, and the 20 dated shows nearest to today (when revealed or with All Access). Avoid calling get_venue in a loop over search results unless you need deeper room notes, stage specs, or dated show history for specific rooms.

tools.name: list_saved_venues
tools.title: List Saved Venues
tools.description: List the signed-in user saved (favorite) venues with level-appropriate venue summaries.

limit.description: Maximum saved venues to return (1-100, default 50).

tools.name: list_shortlists
tools.title: List Saved Shortlists
tools.description: List the signed-in All Access user's saved shortlists (names, IDs, and seed artists/venues) so they can be passed to find_similar_venues.

tools.name: remove_saved_venue
tools.title: Remove Saved Venue
tools.description: Remove a venue from the signed-in user favorites list.

venue_id.description: Venue slug identifier to remove from favorites.

tools.name: reveal_venue
tools.title: Reveal Full Venue Details
tools.description: Unlock and return an active venue dossier (booking contacts, dead-email warnings, submission rules, typical ticket prices, usual music days, room/load-in context, and dated show listings) for 7 days by spending 1 free reveal if the venue is not already revealed. Permanently closed venues cannot be revealed and spend no reveal. Call this only when the user explicitly asks to reveal or unlock a specific venue.

tools.name: save_venue
tools.title: Save Venue to Favorites
tools.description: Save a venue to the signed-in user favorites list so it syncs across the No Stairs Please website and MCP clients.

tools.name: search_performers
tools.title: Search Bands & Local Support Acts
tools.description: Discover bands and solo performers across all 50 US states, Washington, DC, and British Columbia by name keyword, home state, home city, genre, or touring tier — useful for finding local support acts, peer bands, or exact artist names before calling find_by_performer or find_similar_venues. Full dossiers require All Access; signed-in free accounts receive aggregate counts.

query.description: Optional performer name keyword or prefix.

state.description: Optional home state/jurisdiction code (all 50 US states, "DC", "BC") or full name.

activity_tier.description: Optional activity tier filter: "local" (emerging + active local), "touring" (regional + national), or an exact tier ("emerging_local", "active_local", "regional_touring", "national_represented").

tools.name: search_venues
tools.title: Search Live Music Venues
tools.description: Search live music venues across all 50 US states, Washington, DC, and British Columbia by keyword, state, regional drive-time area, town or multi-stop driving route corridor (stops, or near / to / within_miles), venue type, genre (free account or All Access), room capacity, usual music days, admission model / ticket price (All Access), or saved favorites. Returns each venue with room capacity, load-in/context signals, genres (account/pass), usual music days and ticket prices (All Access/revealed), and booking contacts (All Access/revealed), and renders the interactive No Stairs Please directory widget.

query.description: Keyword query matching venue name, city, address, venue type, or (with a signed-in account / All Access) genres, performers, and booking contacts. Omit narrow genre keywords when searching a town or route (or use the `genre` filter) so matching venues are returned cleanly for comparison.

state.description: Two-letter state or jurisdiction code across all 50 US states, Washington, DC, and British Columbia (e.g. "TX", "TN", "NC", "IL", "NY", "WA", "DC", "BC") or full name (e.g. "Texas", "British Columbia").

area.description: Regional drive-time area named for its hub town (e.g. "Austin area", "Chicago area", "Denver area", "Seattle area"). An area that matches nothing returns no venues and lists the closest areas.

near.description: Origin town ("Austin, TX") or "lat, lng" coordinate pair.

to.description: Optional destination town ("Nashville, TN") or "lat, lng" to search along a driving route corridor from near to to.

stops.description: Ordered list of 2 to 15 towns or "lat, lng" stops to build a multi-stop driving route (e.g. ["Nashville, TN", "Asheville, NC", "Richmond, VA", "Philadelphia, PA"]). Venues are returned in stop-to-stop progression order along the road.

within_miles.description: Maximum distance in miles from near or from the driving route corridor (default 25).

venue_type.description: Venue category such as "Music venue", "Bar & pub", "Brewery & taproom", "Restaurant", "Coffee shop", "Winery & tasting room", "Hall & arts center", "Outdoor stage", "Listening room", "Hotel & resort", "Ski area", "Church", "Community space". A venue type that matches nothing returns no venues and lists the valid types.

genre.description: Optional genre or performance style tag (e.g. "folk", "americana", "country", "bluegrass", "indie", "rock", "blues", "jazz", "soul-rnb", "punk-metal", "hip-hop", "electronic", "latin-world", "acoustic", "singer-songwriter", "originals"). Requires a free account or All Access.

min_capacity.description: Minimum room capacity (e.g. 500 for 500+ cap rooms).

music_days.description: Filter by usual live music days of the week (All Access).

admission.description: Filter by typical admission model: free, paid, or donation (All Access).

min_ticket_price.description: Minimum typical ticket price in dollars (All Access).

max_ticket_price.description: Maximum typical ticket price in dollars (All Access).

favorites_only.description: Filter to venues saved in the signed-in user account.

limit.description: Maximum number of venues to return (1-50, default 25).
